techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.developer: RMZ Corp (developer); Brookfield Properties / Brookfield India REIT owns the original campuses (Arliga Ecoworld Business Parks Pvt Ltd); RMZ retains Ecoworld 20 and Ecoworld 30
techParks.description: The largest office campus on the Bellandur stretch of ORR, established 2016 on about 48 acres with 15 completed Grade-A blocks (Campus 1-9, each split into A/B/C/D towers) and 7.7 million sq ft of leasable space, 94% committed as of Brookfield's FY2026 note; it is the single largest asset in the Brookfield India REIT. RMZ's own newer phases, Ecoworld 20 (where Disney leased floors 6-7 in 2026) and Ecoworld 30 (Campus 30-33, 3.55 million sq ft in four towers, home to Ryan, Haleon and several flexible-office operators), carry the same name. Key occupiers named by the owner are Honeywell, Morgan Stanley, Shell, KPMG, Deloitte, State Street, Standard Chartered and Cadence; Capgemini, KPIT, BT, Allstate, Virtusa and BCG also give Ecoworld addresses. Centroid and bbox are derived from the OSM building polygons for Campus 1-9 and 30-33, because OSM has no landuse polygon for the park itself.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecospace
techParks.locality: Bellandur (Outer Ring Road, beside Adarsh Palm Retreat)
techParks.description: RMZ's first large ORR campus, a roughly 12-year-old low-rise Grade-A park of nine office buildings (Campus 1A/1B/1C, 2, 3A/3B, 4A/4B) on 18-25 acres with about 1.5 million sq ft of offices (RMZ's own page quotes 2.13 million sq ft across 9 towers), sold to Brookfield in 2020. Deloitte (Ecospace 3A), Microland (its headquarters at 1B), Broadcom (1A/1C), Bosch and Shell Business Operations (1B) are the occupiers substantiated here. Note that the adjoining Pritech Park SEZ shares its internal road and is routinely addressed as 'Ecospace' by tenants, and the OSM polygon used for the centroid covers both.

techParks.name: Pritech Park SEZ
techParks.developer: RGA Software Systems / Primal Projects Pvt Ltd (Pritech Projects as landlord)
techParks.description: A 38-acre IT/ITeS Special Economic Zone of about 4.3 million sq ft in numbered blocks (4A, 5A/5B, 6, 7A/7B, 8, 9A/9B, 10, 12B, 14, Annexe/15) completed from 2008, sharing an internal road with RMZ Ecospace and therefore often written as 'Pritech Park (Ecospace)'. Accenture is the anchor (Blocks 7, 10, 14 and 15, consolidated to 566,617 sq ft in a 2026 renewal), with Intuit (4A, 6A, 8), Capgemini (6B), HP (Block 6), Subex (Block 9) and Impetus (14B) among the others. Centroid and bbox derived from the OSM building polygons for its blocks.

techParks.name: Global Technology Park
techParks.description: Mapletree's 12-acre, LEED Gold business park of about 1.9 million sq ft in Towers A-E (Phase 1 Towers A and B of ~480,000 sq ft each, Phase 2 Towers C, D and E), the original tenant being LSI Logic in 2011. Property listings name Arista Networks, Vodafone Global Services/_VOIS, LinkedIn, GSN Games, SoftwareONE and Tangoe as occupiers; Marvell's own site gives Towers D and E. Mapletree has been reported to be marketing the park for sale with bids from Embassy, Actis and GIC.

techParks.name: Mantri Commercio
techParks.locality: Devarabeesanahalli, Bellandur (Outer Ring Road, near Sakra World Hospital)
techParks.description: A two-tower (A and B) mid-size office complex on the lake side of ORR at Devarabeesanahalli, best known as an early Flipkart office. Blue Yonder's own site gives Tower A as its Bangalore office; Rapido and a cluster of flexible-office operators (Innov8 on the 5th floor, 2gethr in Tower B, Spatium in Tower A) are the other substantiated occupiers. A broker page claims about 6,500 people work on the campus.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.locality: Bellandur (Outer Ring Road, Green Glen Layout)
techParks.description: An IGBC Platinum office complex of about 1.0 million sq ft leasable (91% committed as of March 2025, per Sattva) on Survey Nos. 80/1, 81/1 and 81/2 of Bellandur Village, under 1 km from the coming Bellandur and Iblur metro stations. PhonePe's registered office is on the 5th floor of Block A, Wing A, and Deloitte occupies the 2nd to 4th floors.

techParks.name: Intel India SRR Campus
techParks.locality: Devarabeesanahalli, Bellandur (Outer Ring Road, opposite Global Technology Park)
techParks.description: Intel's own 44-acre campus on the Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli, its largest design and engineering site outside the United States, with buildings SRR1-SRR5; the 620,000 sq ft SRR4 design house opened in 2022 after an announced Rs 1,100 crore expansion. Owner-occupied, so not a multi-tenant park, but it is the single largest employer site on this stretch other than Ecoworld. Centroid from the OSM landuse polygon named 'Intel'.

coverageNotes: WEB SEARCH BUDGET: the shared per-turn WebSearch limit was exhausted about two-thirds of the way through, so the later companies were verified only through direct fetches of company pages and the two OSM extracts; several fetches were blocked (403/429/404: Mapletree property page, Brookfield India REIT Ecoworld PDF, Intuit locations page on retry, SocGen locations page, Navi, Allstate, EPAM, Saviynt, State Street, Standard Chartered GBS, Haleon, HGS). PARKS: Vaswani Centropolis is NOT in this lens - every listing places it at No. 21 Langford Road, Shanti Nagar; the Bellandur 'Simpliwork - Vaswani Centropolis' hit is a flexible-office operator in Shakti Statesman, so no Centropolis park entry was written. Bagmane Solarium City is in Mahadevapura (12.9699, 77.7084), outside this stretch, and was left out. RMZ Ecoworld has no OSM landuse polygon, so its centroid/bbox are derived from the OSM building polygons for Campus 1-9 and 30-33; Ecoworld 20 and Ecoworld 30 (RMZ-retained) are folded into the one CANON entry with aliases rather than split. Pritech Park SEZ and RMZ Ecospace share an internal road and tenants address both as 'Ecospace'; blocks 4A and above with 'Pritech' in the company's own address are filed under Pritech Park SEZ, Campus 1A/1B/1C/3A under RMZ Ecospace, and the single OSM polygon 'RMZ Ecospace' covers both. Intel's owner-occupied SRR campus is recorded as a named corporate campus because it is the largest single site on the stretch outside Ecoworld. TENANTS ASKED ABOUT BUT NOT PLACED HERE: Amazon (no Bellandur evidence; its ORR offices are Bagmane WTC/Constellation and Brigade WTC), Micron (OSM pin is inside Embassy TechVillage, another lens; its listed addresses are Ulsoor), Uber (OSM pins at Sarjapur Road and near Prestige Lakeshore Drive, no address and no company confirmation), Amadeus (Amadeus Labs is at Prestige Tech Park, Kadubeesanahalli - other lens), Rolls-Royce (its GCC is at Manyata Embassy Business Park, opened Sept 2025 - other lens), Lowe's, ServiceNow and Alstom (no source placed them on this stretch), Workday (Dec 2025 press release says it has no Bengaluru office yet), Infosys BPM (HQ Electronics City, nothing here), Visa (its 2015 tech centre is at Bagmane WTC).
